formulas.formula: Pay off your car faster and see every dollar of interest you save.
Loan: type your loan amount, APR, term and first payment date. Payment fills itself in (or type your own).
Loan: add an extra amount you can pay every month. Even $50 cuts months and interest.
Schedule: every month of the loan. Type one-time extras (tax refund, bonus) in the Extra column.
Schedule: tick Paid each month you pay. The Dashboard tracks your real progress.
Payoff Goal: pick a date to be car-loan-free and see the payment it takes.
Car Costs: insurance, gas and upkeep for the true monthly cost of your car.
Ask your lender to apply extra money to principal, not the next payment.
The Schedule keeps a second balance with no extras, so you can see what you saved.
Grey cells calculate. No need to touch.
Red means something needs a look.
Drive it like you own it. Soon you will.
